title: Convergence rates for a rotating MHD system with evanescent viscosity
summary: In this article, we focus on a MHD model that takes into account the Coriolis force. In this case, the strength of the rotation is measured by the Rossby number $ε$ (positive). Under the assumption that the rotation is strong (that is, when $ε$ goes to zero) and the kinematic viscosity goes to zero as $ε$^$α$ ($α$ positive), we first establish the global convergence of weak solutions, and then prove the global existence and convergence of strong solutions.
